hypotheses.title: Gold First 4 Daily Submissions: High-Conviction Engines Targeting EXCELLENT and SPECTACULAR Status
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Deploys our proven statistical and volatility engines engineered to overcome the self-correlation ceiling (< 0.70) and turnover hurdles to achieve platform ratings of GOOD (Fitness >= 1.50), EXCELLENT (Fitness >= 1.80), and SPECTACULAR (Fitness >= 2.20, Sharpe >= 2.10): (1) 90-Day Fresh Quarterly FX Translation in TOP1000: Upgrades the proven 8/8 PASS alpha (self-corr 0.5602) by accelerating adaptation from 252d to 90d to propel Fitness past 1.55. (2) Consensus Adjusted Net Income Yield in TOP1000: Migrates the Sharpe 2.02 engine to TOP1000 with a 10% reversal stabilizer to decorrelate and compress turnover. (3) 1-Year Call Volatility Term Premium in TOP1000 with Decay 6: Decouples the Sharpe 2.25 / Fitness 1.53 options engine into large caps with smoothed turnover. (4) Multi-Factor Super Alpha (Options + FX): Synthesizes orthogonal options volatility flow with corporate balance sheet currency hedging, targeting EXCELLENT rating with cross-asset diversification.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if institutional options demand reflects hedging panic rather than informed directional conviction.
